Step by Step PEO appointment booking

PoliticsUKBAPEOPremium service appointmentUKBA appointment


  1. Create UKBA account.

  2. Log-on the UKBA site.

  3. Next page , click 'Book Appointment' button.

  4. Question is : 'Which service are you applying for?'  -> Learn them beforehand and answer appropriately.. (eg choose SET(O) for ILR based on employment based categories)

  5. Next screen, 'Are you applying using the premium service?' -> Select YES

  6. Remember to put any dependents with you.

  7. Put the range of dates you wish to apply.  You could select maximum upto 3 PEO's.

  8. It will present the suitable options. Select and Then press NEXT with the suitable date

  9. Confirm.

  10. Ensure you receive Email confirmation
